full_judgment:
This Rule was issued calling upon the opposite party to show cause why the judgment and decree passed by the learned Additional District Judge, Kushtia in Title Appeal No. 138 of 1980. affirming the Judgment and decree passed by the learned Munsif, 1st Court, Kushtia, in Title Suit No. 618 of 1979, decreeing the suit for eviction should not be set aside. 

 The learned Munsif considered the case on merit and held that defendant petitioner’s arc defaulters but that plaintiff opposite party could not prove bonafide requirement of the suit premises. He, however, decreed the suit. 

 3. Being aggrieved the defendant petitioner moved this Court and obtained the rule. During the pendency of the rule the operation of the impugned judgment and decree was stayed. The opposite party appeared and opposed the rule. 

 The order staying the operation of the impugned judgment and decree is vacated.
